faqs.q: How long until I can return to work?
faqs.a: Most back pain patients return to desk work in 2–4 weeks with 6–8 sessions. Surgery rehab takes longer — we give you a week-by-week target.
Yes. We do home visits 7 days a week in Andheri and nearby areas. Same physiotherapist, same treatment — we bring the equipment.
45–60 minutes. The first assessment is 45 minutes. Home visits are 45–60 minutes depending on your condition.
Some stretching is uncomfortable — that is normal. We work within your pain limit and explain every step. Pain should never be sharp.

faqs.q: When should I start after surgery?
faqs.a: Usually 3–7 days after, with your surgeon's permission. We get the discharge summary and start safely.

faqs.q: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.a: Most problems improve in 6–12 sessions. Chronic pain and post-surgery rehab need 12–20. You will know the plan at the first assessment.
Loose, comfortable clothes and a pair of shorts. You will move, so skip tight jeans and heavy jewellery.
Yes. We run return-to-sport programs with strength tests, so you know exactly when you can play again.

costFaqs.q: Should I take sessions or a package?
costFaqs.a: Packages save 12–18% and keep you consistent. If your condition is short-term, pay per session — no pressure to buy a package.

costFaqs.q: Are there extra charges for home visits?
costFaqs.a: No. Travel is included within 5 km of Andheri. Beyond that, we confirm a small travel fee before booking.
Free cancellation up to 2 hours before your session. You can reschedule by phone or WhatsApp.
We give cash receipts for all sessions. Most insurers reimburse physiotherapy under outpatient cover — check with your insurer.
Yes. We assess before treating — it keeps your treatment safe and stops you paying for sessions that do not fit your condition.
